200.title: Polish parliament concludes work on DSA implementation
200.summary: The lower chamber of Poland's parliament adopted the senate's amendments to the second act implementing the EU's Digital Services Act (DSA), which aims to ensure more effective responses to illegal online content, including hate speech and material that endangers the safety of children. Thus, the parliament concluded its stage of the legislative process.
200.body: The lower chamber of Poland's parliament adopted the senate's amendments to the second act implementing the EU's Digital Services Act (DSA), which aims to ensure more effective responses to illegal online content, including hate speech and material that endangers the safety of children. 400.title: Greenvolt sells 400 MW/1,600 MWh BESS projects in Poland
400.summary: Greenvolt Group, through Greenvolt Power, has agreed to sell two standalone battery energy storage system (BESS) projects in Poland to A&R Investments. The projects are located in Ełk and Turośń Kościelna in north-eastern Poland, and have a total installed capacity of 400 MW/1,600 MWh.
400.body: Greenvolt Group, through Greenvolt Power, has agreed to sell two standalone battery energy storage system (BESS) projects in Poland to A&R Investments. The projects are located in Ełk and Turośń Kościelna in north-eastern Poland, and have a total installed capacity of 400 MW/1,600 MWh. Both projects were completed in the third quarter of 2026 and have received the required permits for use. Earlier, in October 2026, Greenvolt Power raised € 284 million in project financing for its 253.1 MW wind project in Gurbănești, located east of Bucharest, Romania.

400.title: Home solar owners in Poland can pair panels with bigger batteries, if exports stay capped
400.summary: Tech Home solar owners in Poland can pair panels with bigger batteries, if exports stay capped The change could expand backup power and load-shifting options. by Leslie Sattler October 25, 2026 share Facebook " target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"> Twitter Link Copied!
400.body: Tech Home solar owners in Poland can pair panels with bigger batteries, if exports stay capped The change could expand backup power and load-shifting options. by Leslie Sattler October 25, 2026 share Facebook " target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"> Twitter Link Copied! Photo Credit: iStock A new rule in Poland will let households with rooftop solar panels add larger home batteries without automatically having that extra battery power counted toward the system size used for grid connections. Here's what to know Effective December 1, an amendment to Poland's Renewable Energy Sources Act will keep a battery connected to a micro-installation out of the installation's counted power total if two conditions are met: The battery's rated power is no more than 2.2 times the photovoltaic system's power, and total power sent to the grid remains below the solar system's rating, ESS News reported.

500.title: NVIDIA unveils architecture for secure enterprise AI agents
500.summary: It includes NVIDIA Vera Rubin infrastructure for running enterprise workloads, including closed and open models built with NVIDIA Nemotron ; NVIDIA Vera CPUs for operating agent harnesses; open source NVIDIA OpenShell software; and NVIDIA BlueField DPUs for running the NVIDIA Sentry unified security software framework that provides continuous out-of-band monitoring of agent behavior and in-silicon policy enforcement.
500.body: NVIDIA today announced the NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture , which enables building, containing, observing and enforcing safe agents on enterprise infrastructure and edge systems. It includes NVIDIA Vera Rubin infrastructure for running enterprise workloads, including closed and open models built with NVIDIA Nemotron ; NVIDIA Vera CPUs for operating agent harnesses; open source NVIDIA OpenShell software; and NVIDIA BlueField DPUs for running the NVIDIA Sentry unified security software framework that provides continuous out-of-band monitoring of agent behavior and in-silicon policy enforcement. The OpenShell Reference Architecture is extensible to agents running at the edge across industries such as retail, healthcare, manufacturing, robotics, software development and telecommunications with NVIDIA RTX Spark , NVIDIA DGX Spark and NVIDIA DGX Station systems. NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPUs continuously monitor agent behavior with NVIDIA Sentry , built on NVIDIA DOCA software.
